violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving (26 TAC §747.3101(e))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving
violation_type.typical_finding: I observed a child in care request seconds and it was denied by the provider in the home.

finding_variants.text: I observed a child in care request seconds and it was denied by the provider in the home.
There was not enough food served to provide for a second serving of vegetable, fruit, grain, and milk groups.

Because it is unlikely that every child in care will request two servings from every food group, you do not need to prepare a quantity of food that allows two servings for every child in care. You need to have enough food from each of the required food groups so that if a child requests a second serving, there is enough to fulfill the child's request.
